fullPassage: I had never seen a beach with such white sand or water that was such a beautiful shade of blue. Jane and I set up a blanket on the sand while looking forward to our ten days of honeymooning on an exotic island. "Look!" Jane waved her hand to point at the beautiful scene before us — and her gold wedding ring went flying off her hand. I tried to see where it went, but the sun hit my eyes and I lost track of it. I didn't want to lose her wedding ring, so I started looking in the area where I thought it had landed. However, the sand was so fine and I realized that anything heavy, like gold, would quickly sink and might never be found again.

det.korean: what → that : 사물 선행사 뒤 관계대명사
det.analysis:
③ what: 'water ______ was such a beautiful shade'에서 앞에 선행사 water(사물)가 있으므로 관계대명사 that(또는 which)이 와야 함. 선행사를 포함하는 what은 앞에 명사가 있으면 쓸 수 없어 비문 ←정답

① never: 'I had never seen' 과거완료 부사 ✅

② such: 'such white sand' (such+명사) ✅

④ waved: 'Jane waved her hand' 과거형 정동사 ✅
det.tip: 선행사(water)가 있으면 that/which, 없으면 what

② tried: 'I tried to see' 과거형 정동사 ✅

det.tip: 본동사 자리 → 정동사 과거형(went), 과거분사(gone) 단독 불가

det.analysis: 이야기가 과거시제로 서술되므로 wave를 과거형 waved로 바꿉니다. 'e로 끝나는 동사'는 -d만 붙여 waved. 'Jane이 손을 흔들었다'는 의미.
